observations: Two pointed ear-like forms rise from the top of the head, outlined in red-orange over black fill, with yellow and teal triangles nested inside them.
The face is built from layered loops of red, yellow, green, blue, and white lines crossing over a dark base, with two rectangular eye zones and a wide-open mouth showing white teeth at the bottom.
White spiked lines radiate upward from the crown area, and loose scribbled loops in pink, cyan, and lime extend beyond the face outline into the flat teal background.
reading: A dense, snarling face fills most of the canvas, its features stacked vertically and outlined in competing colors rather than blended. The rectangular eye zones and bared teeth carry a confrontational charge, while the radiating white spikes and scribbled loops spilling into the background give the form an outward, unsettled pressure. The flat teal ground keeps all that line energy contained.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors #116 and #118. Where #116 uses a muted purple-brown ground with softer, diffuse marks, #117 shares the flat teal ground of #118, pairing high-contrast color stacking with a more frontal face structure.

connections.reason: Both works share the same flat teal background and use a wide row of white teeth as a dominant horizontal anchor across the lower face, making the ground-and-teeth pairing a direct visual echo between these title neighbors in the owned subset.

nnotb #18 shares the same teal background tone and carries a densely layered head with spiked crown forms and red circular eye marks; the collector links these across collections through shared visual qualities, not confirmed formal relationship.

lookingQuestion: Where does the boundary between the face and the background actually end — and what happens to the lines that cross it?
ambiguities: The spiked white forms at the crown could read as hair, a headdress element, or purely abstract marks; no supplied evidence resolves this.
The teal-ground similarity between #117 and nnotb #18 may be coincidental; flagged as a collector-perspective visual link only.
